notes.title: V2 Update
notes.notes: This update solves problems related to drastic performance when walking, fps drops, Steam menu overlay, achievements in general, solving conflict problems with antivirus, game statistics and other small related problems that bothered some players, I hope you like it, I'm doing it as much as possible to make guilty me fun for everyone

notes.title: Release Date
notes.notes: HKGamesSTUDIO is pleased to announce that the highly anticipated release of Guilty Me is scheduled for August 1, 2023! Get ready to dive into a world of puzzles and discoveries that will challenge your skills and test your mettle.
